title: Aureline M5 educational-AI panels and practice indicators
description: Boundary schema for the educational-AI and practice manifest. An educational panel is an educational-AI answer panel or a contextual why-now card that a person reads while they work across an M5 feature family. When it claims repository truth it MUST cite the files, symbols, docs, examples, or commands it draws from, and it MUST keep an open-source/open-docs action one step away, so an answer never sounds omniscient or action-capable. Its explain/apply class keeps explain separate from do: any prepared mutation rides the standard preview/approval model, never a hidden shortcut; a panel that conflates explain and do, presents as omniscient, claims it can act directly without approval, or traps an expert in a tutorial narrows below Stable. A practice indicator declares a practice/sandbox surface's target scope, reset/discard behavior, persistence note, and whether the surface is local-only, simulated, or running against live repository state, so a low-risk teaching space is always visibly distinct from the live workspace. A practice surface that is not distinct from the live workspace, mutates live state outside the standard preview/approval model, omits its target scope or persistence note, or whose work is neither reversible nor discardable narrows below Stable; a live-repo-state practice surface is an honest, disclosed higher-risk choice that narrows to Beta. Both records are educational overlays and carry an overlay presentation that MUST respect quiet-hours and reduced-motion, stay keyboard reachable and screen-reader labeled, stay client-scoped rather than broadcast globally, and never spam an attention surface; an overlay that dies on offline/mirror profiles is a dead link that narrows below Stable, while a disclosed cached/mirror-stale freshness narrows to Beta. Each record's verdict is the strictest verdict folded from its evidence, and the manifest carries the narrowest overall verdict. Raw URLs, raw absolute paths, and raw credential material MUST NOT appear; the schema carries opaque ids, typed vocabulary, and short privacy-safe labels only. The surface-family taxonomy aligns with schemas/learning/m5-feature-family-learning-rails.schema.json and the verdict vocabulary with schemas/learning/guided-learning-contracts.schema.json. Adding a new record_kind, surface kind, citation kind, truth-source scope, open-resource kind, practice surface state, reset behavior, offline parity, or surface family is additive-minor; repurposing an existing value is breaking.

schema_version.description: Integer schema version for educational-AI and practice records. Current value is 1. Bumped only on breaking payload changes.

opaque_id.description: Opaque, stable identifier. Raw URLs, raw absolute paths, and raw secret material MUST NOT appear.

reason_array.description: Named narrowing reasons. Empty when the verdict is qualified_stable.

qualification_verdict.description: Derived lifecycle verdict for a record or the overall manifest.

m5_learning_surface_family.description: One M5 feature family a record belongs to.

educational_surface_kind.description: Whether a panel is an educational-AI answer panel or an in-place why-now card.

citation_kind.description: The kind of repository truth a citation points at.

truth_source_scope.description: The scope label a panel attaches to the truth it claims.

open_resource_kind.description: The kind of open-the-source action a panel keeps one step away.

practice_surface_state.description: Whether a practice surface is local-only, simulated, or live repository state.

reset_behavior.description: How a practice surface resets or discards its work.

explain_apply_class.description: The explain-versus-do boundary. Only fully_separated, apply_requires_approval, and read_only qualify Stable.

offline_parity.description: How an educational overlay behaves on offline and mirrored profiles. missing_on_offline is a dead link that narrows below Stable.

steps_away.description: Number of steps to reach the action from the panel. MUST be 1 (one step away).

respects_quiet_hours.description: Whether the overlay respects quiet-hours. MUST be true.

respects_reduced_motion.description: Whether the overlay respects reduced-motion. MUST be true.

keyboard_reachable.description: Whether the overlay is keyboard reachable. MUST be true — no pointer-only paths.

screen_reader_labeled.description: Whether the overlay is screen-reader labeled. MUST be true.

client_scoped_not_global.description: Whether the overlay is scoped to the local client rather than pushed globally. MUST be true.

spams_attention_surface.description: Whether the overlay may spam an attention surface. MUST be false.

claims_repository_truth.description: Whether the panel claims repository truth (and therefore must cite it).

citations.description: Citations backing the panel's claims. MUST be non-empty when the panel claims live repository truth.

open_resource_actions.description: Open-source/open-docs actions kept one step away. MUST be non-empty when the panel claims repository truth.

presents_as_omniscient.description: Whether the panel presents as omniscient. MUST be false.

claims_direct_action_without_approval.description: Whether the panel claims it can act directly without approval. MUST be false.

mutation_routes_through_standard_preview.description: Whether any prepared mutation routes through the standard preview/approval model. MUST be true when the explain/apply class admits an Apply verb.

traps_expert_in_tutorial.description: Whether the panel traps an expert in a tutorial. MUST be false.

allOf.description: A panel claiming live repository truth must cite it.
A panel claiming repository truth must keep an open-source/open-docs action one step away.
An apply-gated panel must route its do through the standard preview/approval model.

target_scope_refs.description: Opaque refs to the targets the practice surface may touch. MUST be non-empty.

distinct_from_live_workspace.description: Whether the surface is visibly distinct from the live workspace. MUST be true.

mutates_live_state.description: Whether the surface mutates live repository state.

mutation_routes_through_standard_preview.description: Whether any live mutation routes through the standard preview/approval model. MUST be true when the surface mutates live state.

reversible_or_discardable.description: Whether the surface's work is reversible or discardable. MUST be true.

allOf.description: A surface that mutates live state must fence the mutation behind the standard preview/approval model.

contract_refs.description: Schema, docs, and contract refs this manifest consumes.
